title: Chapter 116 Lord Zach Appears
content:
Chapter 116 Lord Zach Appears

Wana Village.

Wang Shuo also saw the message in the group at this moment.

He was secretly happy.

Then, he thought about it and sent a message in the group.

"I, Wang Shuo, the lord of Wana Village, welcome everyone to Wana Village to build a home of our own together and create a place to settle down in this troubled time. The location is 50 miles north of Nanshanji."

Exposing the location of his territory was not a whim, but a well-considered choice.

With the development in the later period, the location of everyone's village is not a secret and can be easily detected.

Let more people know earlier, it can attract more refugees to come, which can greatly accelerate the development of the territory. After all, talent is the foundation of everything.

After sending the message, Wang Shuo wanted to see if there were any players responding.

At this time, a familiar mysterious voice sounded in his mind.

And just after he sent the message, countless lords suddenly realized and followed suit in the group.

"I, Tailang Village, invite all players to seek common development. The location is..."

Some people even used Wang Shuo's name directly. Who cares? Let's trick people here first.

"I am the real Wang Shuo. My territory is 20 miles west of Nanshanji. Welcome everyone."

"Don't believe him. The person above is a liar. I am Wang Shuo's subordinate territory. The treatment is the same as Wana Village. The location is 30 miles north of Xiaochi Town. We are also responsible for transportation. As long as you are willing to come, we are good brothers. Let's conquer the world together..."

Wang Shuo naturally couldn't see the following words of these people.

Because, in front of him, an old man suddenly appeared.

Wang Shuo saw that the other people around him did not react in particular. He understood that only he could see this old man.

"Congratulations, you have won a great victory."

Wang Shuo was not panicked, because from the voice, he had judged that this person was the servant of God, Lord Zak.

Lord Zak's voice was full of energy, but slightly hoarse.

Wang Shuo thought it would be a middle-aged man, but unexpectedly, it was an old man.

"Are you Lord Zak?"

Wang Shuo's tone was calm, and the surprise on his face was well hidden.

"Aren't you curious about how I appeared in front of you?"

Wang Shuo's calm expression made Lord Zak a little interested.

"Lord Zak, you are mysterious and unpredictable. Your thoughts are unpredictable! And your appearance does not threaten my safety. If you want to harm me, you only need a thought. I naturally have nothing to fear."

"Not bad, stay calm in the face of danger!" Lord Zak nodded approvingly.

"Do you want to know why so many beasts besieged you? And there are 11 bosses, and even a golden boss?"

Wang Shuo thought about it. This Lord Zak must have appeared this time because he performed well in this battle. He should be in a good mood.

Isn't this question clearly asking me to tell you the answer?

Wang Shuo smiled and nodded, "Of course, I'd like to hear more!"

"I guess you already know that there are more vast areas outside this Dahuai area!"

Wang Shuo did not interrupt Lord Zak, but nodded obediently.

"Yes, the lords outside the area can influence the game process here within certain rules."

"And this time, half of the beasts in Changping County came to besiege you, which was the request of the Iron-blooded Lord."
